verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework operated through a conventional CLI (`proa new`, `proa ui add`, `proa site routes`) and code. A framework could plausibly ship a natural-language interface, so the axis applies. The agent-facing aids (scaffolded AGENTS.md, Markdown docs routes, /llms-full.txt) help external AI agents read the docs but do not let users operate Proa itself with natural-language commands. Those are adjacent features and earn no credit.
